label: hand-checked
how: Codes: every GTIN only one reader returned was checked by reading its place in the notice text (read through the gateway). TRUE = a product barcode the notice prints; codes the notice labels as case or shipper codes are FALSE. Allergens: every notice where the model and the lexicon disagree was read by hand; truth = the allergen groups the reason text names as undeclared (wheat counts as the gluten family; coconut is not a tree nut, as in FDA's Edition 5 guidance that ClearShelf follows). full_read: notices drawn at random (seeded) and read in full, every printed barcode listed.
